content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00177, SRS_Rte_00245 If an AtomicSwComponentType using a PortPrototype with an NvDataInter- face invokes the explicit API Rte_Write and the attribute is set to true and the writ- ing strategy storeCyclic ([SWS_Rte_04565] applies) is enabled, the RTE shall write the associated RAM Block (s) to NV memory by calling the NvM_WritePRAMBlock func- tion of the NvM module in the next cycle of a periodic activity after the data accessed by the Rte_Write function is written back to the RAM Block (s). The periodic activ- ity shall be implemented in the context of an NvBlockDescriptor ’s RunnableEn- tity (see requirements [SWS_Rte_08086], [SWS_Rte_08087], [SWS_Rte_08089], [SWS_Rte_08090]) according to the cycle period defined in the attribute NvBlockDe- scriptor . timingEvent . period .
